scope: single-Mother trial for workflows that publish a mutable shared entry
trigger: two or more independently dispatched candidates can write the same public alias, branch path or canonical pointer
assertions: local candidate verification does not grant permission to mutate a shared target
the expected target identity must exactly equal the target identity observed immediately before the state-changing write
a mismatched target is held without force push or automatic rebase-and-retry
after a concurrent advance, the replacement candidate must include all required predecessor deltas and rerun their applicable tests
a shared concurrency group reduces races but does not replace the target identity precondition

evidenceUpdates.novelty: NO_NOVELTY; validates that a replacement manifest can preserve an already-advanced shared homepage while proving exact public bytes
